title: Vivy Provider Bundle
description: Vivy-owned provider bundle document (D-022..D-025). Field vocabulary is adapted from the Diva providers.yaml schema (D-024) and re-derived; every bundle carries a mandatory provenance record citing the source entry (D-025). Bundles describe shape and defaults only: secrets are never stored here, they are read from the environment variable named by env_key at request time (D-010).

name.description: Stable bundle identifier, e.g. openai, anthropic.

api_type.description: Wire protocol family the provider speaks.

keywords.description: Free-text match tokens for provider detection heuristics.

env_key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key itself is read at request time and never persisted (D-010).

default_model.description: Model id used when the caller does not pin one. Must appear in models.

gateway_prefix.description: Prefix prepended when routing through a gateway; empty for direct providers.

env_extras.description: Additional environment variable names consulted for provider detection. Names only, never values.

default_api_base.description: Default HTTP base URL for the provider API.

models.description: Curated model catalog for this bundle.

backend.description: Implementation backing this bundle: the online eino-ext OpenAI component, or the Vivy-owned thin Anthropic Messages API adapter (no official Eino Anthropic component exists).

source.description: Repository-relative path of the Diva document this bundle was re-derived from (D-025).

entry.description: Entry name in the source document.

note.description: What changed during re-derivation (dropped models, normalized defaults, etc.).
